summary:
Empirical Playwright verification (desktop 1280x900, fullscreen Format editor on https://color-task-timer.preview.emergentagent.com) of the RESTORED BLOCK alignment flow at FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx applyAlign (L1259-L1351). All critical BLOCK scenarios from the review_request PASS on the live app. The three-branch flow is correctly restored: (A) collapsed caret in EMPTY block = align that block in place (toggle rule applies); (B) collapsed caret in NON-EMPTY block = insert a FRESH


immediately AFTER the current block, move caret into it, DO NOT retroactively move existing text; (C) non-collapsed selection = toggle class on every spanned block. The Return-exit behavior (keydown handler L2095-2130) remains unchanged and PASSES (new

after Enter in an aligned block has NO ir-align-* class).

ui_bugs.issue: Pre-existing LOW anomaly from iteration_119/120: clicking floating-rte-btn-bold on a selected plain word does not wrap in <strong>. NOT touched or caused by this iteration's applyAlign restoration.

action_items:
Verified: BLOCK alignment restored to the user-confirmed working flow (empty-block = align-in-place; non-empty-block = insert new aligned

below). No regressions seen on INLINE row creation or Return-exit from aligned block. No action required for the BLOCK alignment change.

critical_code_review_comments:
applyAlign (FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx L1259-L1351) correctly implements the three-branch flow: (1) non-collapsed → collectAlignBlocksInSelection + toggle class on each; (2) collapsed in empty block → toggle class on the block in place with class attribute removal when empty; (3) collapsed in non-empty block → createElement('p'), optional classList.add(className), appendChild(
), parentNode.insertBefore(newBlock, block.nextSibling), Selection.setStart(newBlock,0). Dispatches 'input' event in each branch to notify the save pipeline. Empty detection via textContent.replace(ZWSP,'').replace(/\s/,'').length is reasonable; it correctly treats
-only paragraphs as empty.

Toggle edge case correctly handled: if the caret is in a non-empty block that ALREADY carries the requested class, the fresh

is still inserted below but WITHOUT the class (sameAsCurrent branch), preventing a dead no-op while never mutating the existing block.
File size now ~4360 lines. Extraction of AlignPanel, HighlightPanel, AppearancePanel, and the align keydown helpers into their own modules is overdue — flagged in iteration_120 and still outstanding.
INLINE branch (not touched this iteration) and Return-exit keydown branch (L2095-L2130, not touched this iteration) both verified empirically PASS in iteration_120 — remain consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 7/11 scenarios empirically re-verified PASS (100%); remaining 4 deferred to iteration_120 (same code paths unchanged, previously verified PASS).

s each with their own ir-align-* class containing LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT. Previous text is NEVER mutated when caret is in a non-empty block. Empty-block toggle works. Selection-based multi-block toggle works. Return-exit still clean (new

has no align class). INLINE row creation still PASSES. Fresh browser sessions sometimes don't load IndexedDB notes within 15s — retry the wait if 0 notes are shown.
rca_of_the_issue: User reported iteration_120 had replaced the previously-working BLOCK alignment flow with a Word-like 'always align current block' behavior. The restored applyAlign at L1259-L1351 brings back the three-branch flow the user confirmed working: (empty-in-place / non-empty-insert-below / selection-multi-toggle). Return-exit at L2095-2130 unchanged. INLINE branch unchanged. All three branches empirically verified via Playwright DOM inspection on the public URL.
